title: Reels Script Batch (10)
description: Pick 10 angles from the hook library and client context, then produce 10 complete Reels scripts — 3-second hook, body, CTA, and shot directions — in one draft file.

inputs.label: Hook library CSV path (leave empty if none)

nodes.title: Select 10 angles
nodes.detail: If hook_library_path points to a file, read it and pick unused hooks that fit the audience; otherwise design hooks from the niche and audience directly. Lock in 10 angles (hook + topic + format type) mixing different trigger types — no more than 3 of any one type.
nodes.acceptance: 10 angles locked with 4+ distinct trigger types represented.

subtasks.title: Load and filter the hook library
Lock 10 angles
subtasks.purpose: Hook × topic × format combos with type diversity

nodes.title: Write and save 10 scripts
nodes.detail: Write a Reels script per angle into one markdown file. Each script contains: (1) Hook — the 0–3 second line and on-screen text, (2) Body — 15–30 seconds of dialogue broken into scenes, (3) CTA — a save/share/follow line, (4) Shot directions — per-scene framing, props, and caption placement described in text (no images), (5) a first-caption-line draft. Keep the client's voice consistent across all ten.
nodes.acceptance: All 10 scripts saved with hook, body, CTA, shot directions, and caption line.

subtasks.title: Draft each script scene by scene
subtasks.purpose: Dialogue and on-screen text at shootable detail

subtasks.title: Write shot directions
subtasks.purpose: A creator can film from the directions alone

subtasks.title: Check voice consistency
subtasks.purpose: One client voice across all ten scripts

nodes.title: Verify script completeness
nodes.detail: Check that scripts_written is 10, every script has all four elements (hook, body, CTA, shot directions), no hook line repeats across scripts, and each body stays near a 30-second read (roughly 60–90 words).
